_comment: Thorvald Interceptor variants. box_abs is an ABSOLUTE world-space box on the donor, in the donor's own baked (evaluated) coordinates - print them with 11_islands_baked.py or parts_colour.py. mount is a FRACTION of the host half-extent. size is the chunk's longest dimension in world units. rot_deg is applied to the chunk BEFORE it is mounted.
_reference: reference_sheet_v2_frigate_jets.png - two banded turbine drums on stubby outriggers, long charcoal slab hull, raised copper-rimmed block aft, spine cannon forward.

_donor_notes.wraith_pod: Smuggler frigate (S_Frigate -> Prefab_Wraith) corner thruster. Box -4.32,-2.46 : -4.32,-2.48 : 1.28,3.88 cuts 748 faces, 2.11 x 1.94 x 2.50, drum axis along Z. rot_deg [90,0,0] lays the drum along Y so the intake ring faces forward.
_donor_notes.chronos: 6.10 x 9.29 x 2.77, already near-black charcoal, has a raised block aft. Best hull match.
_donor_notes.kraken: 5.97 x 7.99 x 1.86, lowest-poly (520 tris), flat dark wedge.
_donor_notes.frigate: Renegade Frigate 10.20 x 9.35 x 2.59, long flat grey slab.
